source: The documentation includes a reference-equivalent Python implementation that expands key/value heads with repeat_interleave. It does so to match query-head count. The snippet describes equivalent semantics; it should not be read as a claim that every optimized backend physically materializes repeated K/V tensors.
zh: 该文档包括一个参考等效的 Python 实现，该实现使用 Repeat_interleave 扩展键/值头。这样做是为了匹配查询头计数。该片段描述了等效的语义；它不应该被理解为声称每个优化的后端物理上都实现了重复的 K/V 张量。
